title: Playback API Transcode Boundary Cleanup
problem: nako-api directly depends on nako-transcode for DTO conversion and Admin playback/config fields, which leaks transcode execution vocabulary into API contract ownership.

evidence.summary: Opened the API/transcode boundary cleanup lane, linked it from playback architecture indexes, and validated the workstream JSON plus docs diff checks.

Removed the direct nako-api dependency on nako-transcode by introducing API-owned Admin hardware/readiness DTOs, moving transcode runtime/config conversion into nako-server, and preserving Public Client transcode-plan redaction.
Inventoried the remaining nako-playback to nako-transcode public surface and split the next cleanup to a proposed playback planner value-vocabulary lane.
Verified the lane with focused API/server gates, added closeout notes, and closed the API/transcode boundary cleanup workstream.

continue_policy.notes: Closed on 2026-05-29. Follow-on: open playback-planner-transcode-value-vocabulary if the next goal is to remove nako-playback's direct dependency on nako-transcode.
